query.title: Query
query.description: The question or request in plain English. MUST mention the Salesforce object type (Account, Lead, Contact, OpportunityContactRole, etc.). Do NOT include SOQL or SQL. Example: 'Find all OpportunityContactRole records for Opportunity 006XXXX'.

customizationInstructions.title: Customization Instructions
customizationInstructions.description: Optional custom instructions to optimize the query (e.g., specific fields to include, sort order).
